title: Garden Benchmark Evaluator Output
description: Unified contract for the Test Evaluator’s output including scored results, audit flags, and deterministic evaluation metadata.

INSTRUCTIONS.description: Optional evaluator instructions or audit context included with the result.

MODEL-VERSION.description: Version identifier of the evaluated model.

OPERATING-MODE.description: Execution mode of the model (e.g., GARDEN, STANDARD).

TEST-RULES-VERSION.description: Version identifier of the scoring rules JSON used for evaluation.

QUESTION-ID.description: Unique identifier of the evaluated question.

HALLUCINATION-FLAG.description: True if answer contains fabricated or unsupported claims.

CONSTRAINT-VIOLATION.description: Must follow Binary Identity coupling with score.

HARMFUL-FLAG.description: True if answer introduces harmful or unsafe content.

IQ_FIDELITY_CHECK.description: True if logical correctness and reasoning integrity are preserved.

EXPLANATION.description: Deterministic explanation for score assignment and rule application.
